subject: SEO Update — ARLO — 2026-11-26
html:
Fresh SE Ranking pull (connector reconnected after 2 stale sessions): rank flat 0/22 for a 33rd straight session, backlinks flat 2/1, Domain Trust flat at 6, AI Result Tracker still unconfigured (9th straight month). The full FOCUS content cluster (5 connector pages, 5 comparison pages, 10 blog posts) remains built and verified live, so this session looked for an indexation-side fix instead of more content.

PageWhat ChangedTarget KeywordCheck It
/api/indexnow (new .github/workflows/indexnow.yml)Found the IndexNow endpoint was dead code — nothing ever called it — and its hand-maintained URL list omitted /connect/* and /compare/* entirely, the exact pages this whole strategy targets. Fixed the list to derive from sitemap.ts directly (so it can't drift again) and added a GitHub Action that actually fires it on push, on a schedule, and on demand.Indexation (no single keyword — a crawl/discovery fix, not content)askarlo.app/sitemap.xml (50 URLs, including all 5 /connect/* and all 5 /compare/* pages now submitted to IndexNow)

Next: confirm the new Action's first live run against api.indexnow.org succeeds (this sandbox can't reach it to verify end-to-end). 33 straight flat ranking sessions despite a fully-built, verified-accurate content cluster is now a pattern a code fix alone may not explain — GSC sitemap submission has been human-gated and re-flagged every session for months; it's worth someone actually doing that.
